001package base;
002
003import enums.Role;
004import java.io.Serializable;
005import java.util.UUID;
006import interfaces.Observer;
007
008/**
009 * Abstract base class representing a generic user in the University Management System.
010 * Implements Serializable for data persistence and Observer for the notification system.
011 * @author Batyrbekov Zhanibek, Razyyev Ibrakhim, Yeskenov Aldiyar, Nurdybmek Elizat
012 * @version 2.1
013 */
014public abstract class User implements Serializable, Observer {
015    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
016
017    protected String id;
018    protected String login;
019    protected String passwordHash;
020    protected String name;
021    protected Role role;
022    protected java.util.List<models.Message> messages = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
023
024    /**
025     * Initializes a new user with a unique UUID.
026     * @param login unique username
027     * @param passwordHash pre-hashed password
028     * @param name display name of the user
029     * @param role user's access level/role
030     */
031    protected User(String login, String passwordHash, String name, Role role) {
032        this.id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
033        this.login = login;
034        this.passwordHash = passwordHash;
035        this.name = name;
036        this.role = role;
037    }
038
039    /** @return the unique identification string */
040    public String getId() { return id; }
041    public String getLogin() { return login; }
042    public String getName() { return name; }
043    public Role getRole() { return role; }
044    public String getPassword() { return passwordHash; }
045
046    /**
047     * Checks if the provided raw password matches the stored hash.
048     * @param password raw password input
049     * @return true if matches
050     */
051    public boolean checkPassword(String password) {
052        return this.passwordHash.equals(hashPassword(password));
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * Hashes a password using the String hashCode. 
057     * Note: In a production system, use BCrypt or SHA-256.
058     * @param password raw password
059     * @return hexadecimal representation of the hash
060     */
061    public static String hashPassword(String password) {
062        return Integer.toHexString(password.hashCode());
063    }
064
065    /** Force subclasses to provide specific profile details. */
066    public abstract String getDetails();
067
068    /**
069     * Implementation of the Observer pattern. Prints a notification to the console.
070     * @param news the news content to notify about
071     */
072    @Override
073    public void update(String news) {
074        System.out.println("🔔 [Notification for " + name + "]: " + news);
075    }
076
077    /** Appends an inbox message for this user. */
078    public void receiveMessage(models.Message msg) { this.messages.add(msg); }
079
080    /** @return a mutable list of messages received by this user */
081    public java.util.List<models.Message> getMessages() { return messages; }
082}
